slides.h1: Why Do Astrology Apps Give You Generic Advice?
slides.sub: The honest answer is a design flaw, not a mystery.

slides.body: A rule-based app reads your Sun sign or Moon sign in isolation and prints a matching template. That's the entire computation.

slides.h2: Real charts don't work that way
slides.body: A strong 10th house can sit right next to an afflicted D-10 (career divisional chart) — two signals pointing in different directions, both real.
Hyper-personalized, context-aware guidance — not a horoscope template that reads the same for a million people.
